visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A woman with short brown hair and glasses, wearing a tan blazer over a white shirt and a pearl necklace, sits in an office-like setting. Behind her is a white textured wall and a designer handbag. She gestures with her hands while speaking. (2) Close-up of a person's nose being treated for blackheads with a metal tool. The lighting is bright and focused. (3) A gloved hand applies a clear liquid to a patient's forehead using a cotton swab in a clinical setting. (4) The woman in the blazer returns, gesturing with her hands. Colorful text overlays appear around her. (5) Close-up of a syringe extracting a yellow liquid from a small vial labeled WiQo. (6) A person's face, visibly red, receives the yellow liquid which is then massaged in by gloved hands. (7) A handheld device with a red light is moved across a person's cheek. (8) The woman in the office speaks and smiles, using her hands to emphasize points. (9) Close-up of a person's face showing skin peeling around the cheek area. (10) A 'Before' and 'After' comparison graphic displays a face with significant improvement in acne and skin texture. (11) The woman gestures broadly. (12) Close-up shots of different skin issues: dark spots, pigmentation, and cystic acne are shown as examples. (13) A patient receives a laser-like treatment on their face with a device emitting bright blue and orange light. (14) Final title card shows the clinic logo and contact information including LINE ID, phone number, and addresses.
visual_base.text_narrative_log: (1) [Logo]: 美上美皮膚科診所 DRX DERMATOLOGY CLINIC. [Subtitle]: 如果我要去做臉啊. (2) [Subtitle]: 我可以選擇什麼樣子的酸類去刷? (3) [Subtitle]: 我們的酸類有分很強的, 跟中等強, 還有弱的. [Variety]: 很強的, 中等強, 弱的. (4) [Subtitle]: 如果你今天你就是, 哦我只是進去擠個粉刺. (5) [Subtitle]: 我只想做個保濕, 那你今天你都用弱的. (6) [Subtitle]: 有杏仁酸, 你不要用到很高濃度的. [Variety]: (強度弱的) 杏仁酸 (15%以上). (7) [Subtitle]: 然後還有乳酸, 還有像一些胜肽酸, 或者是低濃度的果酸. [Variety]: 乳酸, 胜肽酸, 低濃度果酸. (8) [Subtitle]: 那中度的呢, 就是說可以選擇一些水楊酸, 或是中濃度的果酸. [Variety]: (強度中等的) 水楊酸, 中濃度果酸. (9) [Subtitle]: 甚至有一個叫 WiQo 的, 它是一個 TCA 煥膚. [Variety]: 它是一個 TCA 煥膚. (10) [Subtitle]: 這個我們自己會加在雷射的術後, 或是我們在做完海菲秀會讓病人擦的. [Variety]: 雷射術後, 我們做完海菲秀. (11) [Subtitle]: 它只會有一點點的小小的屑屑, 但是效果還不錯. [Variety]: 它只會有一點點的小小的屑屑, 效果還不錯. (12) [Subtitle]: 但如果說是強效性的呢, 就是一些強的 A 醇, 強的 A 酸. [Variety]: 強效性的, 強的 A 醇, 強的 A 酸. (13) [Subtitle]: 或是強的 TCA 煥膚, 像藍煥膚, 或者我們的三階段煥膚. [Variety]: 強的 TCA 煥膚, 藍煥膚 (Blue peel), 三階段煥膚. (14) [Subtitle]: 這些就是真地給病人用的. (15) [Subtitle]: 例如說它有嚴重的斑點, 肝斑. [Variety]: 斑點, 肝斑. (16) [Subtitle]: 嚴重的內包型粉刺, 或大的囊腫. [Variety]: 嚴重內包型粉刺, 大囊腫. (17) [Subtitle]: 這些都非常適合這樣強的酸類下去做治療. [Variety]: 強的. (18) [Subtitle]: 所以當然是看你是需要什麼樣子治療的人囉. (19) [Logo]: DRX DERMATOLOGY CLINIC. [Slogan]: LINE @drx.derm, 02-8985-9060, 新北市三重區正義北路104號2F, 台北市中山區南京東路一段96號, 歡迎聯繫我們 contact us.

Frequent digital UI sound effects are layered over the speech, matching the high density of on-screen graphics. narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: This video serves as an educational guide and promotional tool for chemical peel treatments at a dermatology clinic. By categorizing different acids by their intensity and explaining which skin conditions they treat (e.g., blackheads, acne, pigmentation), the speaker positions herself as an expert while showcasing the clinical procedures and results to build trust with potential clients.
